item.isekai_mahou.dire_wolf_pelt.desc: Turns into leather; 3 pelts + string + iron make a saddle.
item.isekai_mahou.harpy_feather.desc: Turns into feathers. In an Awkward Potion: Slow Falling.
item.isekai_mahou.basilisk_scale.desc: Hard as stone. In an Awkward Potion: Slowness.
item.isekai_mahou.basilisk_eye.desc: Use it to petrify the creatures in front of you (consumes the eye).
item.isekai_mahou.mimic_tooth.desc: Said to bring luck. In an Awkward Potion: Luck.
item.isekai_mahou.gargoyle_fragment.desc: Stone that was once alive. In an Awkward Potion: Turtle Master.
item.isekai_mahou.fairy_dust.desc: In the air: float and heal a little. On a block: magic fertilizer. In an Awkward Potion: Regeneration.
message.isekai_mahou.dire_wolf_tamed: The Dire Wolf accepted you as pack leader!
message.isekai_mahou.dire_wolf_saddled: Saddled! Click to ride; hold Space for a high jump.
message.isekai_mahou.basilisk_gaze: Your body starts to stiffen... look away from the basilisk!
message.isekai_mahou.basilisk_petrified: You were petrified by the basilisk's gaze!
message.isekai_mahou.gargoyle_stone: It's solid stone! Use a pickaxe or earth magic.
message.isekai_mahou.fairy_friend: The fairy is now your friend!
